text: Chivas Regal, the Scotch whisky on the Ferrari partner grid, is produced by Chivas Brothers, a subsidiary of Pernod Ricard, a French spirits company traded on Euronext Paris (RI).
short: Chivas Regal is produced by Chivas Brothers, a subsidiary of Pernod Ricard.
